intentions.title: Materialise a durable content graph (content_edges table) from every document's reference fields, working with zero plugins installed as the fresh-install floor
intentions.evidence: projector.ex: 'CORE reference-field edges — Content.extract_edges/2 ... this is the fresh-install floor: it emits edges with ALL plugins off.' project/3 does no DB reads, dedups by {from_id,to_id,kind}.

intentions.title: Let plugins (Tasks, Bulldocs) extend the content graph with their own edge kinds without touching core projection logic
intentions.evidence: projector.ex edges_for_doc/2 folds Registry.collect_edge_extractors/1 over each doc, seeding with core edges as baseline; Tasks projects blocks/discovered-from/parent, Bulldocs projects paper references.

intentions.title: Keep the content graph live and consistent across save/publish/unpublish/delete via debounced background jobs, never blocking the mutating request
intentions.evidence: lifecycle.ex routes after_save/after_publish/after_unpublish/after_delete to ProjectorWorker ops; enqueue_rebuild/1 always returns :ok; ProjectorWorker runs on dedicated :edge_projector Oban queue with 5s debounce.

intentions.title: Offer an incremental per-document upsert path as a spike-gated alternative to full-scope rebuilds, so large corpora don't require a full re-projection on every save
intentions.evidence: settings.ex incremental_project flag (default false, env EDGE_PROJECTOR_INCREMENTAL); projector.ex upsert_record/2 diffs one doc's outbound edges against stored; lifecycle.ex docs it as 'UNPROVEN, spike-gated' because there's no blue/green to discard on a mis-diff.

intentions.title: Guarantee tenancy isolation in the graph: a cross-tenant slug collision or unresolved workspace must never delete or expose another tenant's edges
intentions.evidence: projector.ex doc_pk/2 comment 'TENANCY FAIL-CLOSED (FIX 3)'; Scope.scope_to_workspace/3 fails closed on nil workspace; projector_worker.ex run_rebuild/4 cancels {:cancel, :nil_workspace_multi_tenant} rather than list a cross-tenant corpus.

intentions.title: Prevent projection debounce collapse from silently dropping work across doc types (a save burst of one type must not swallow a different type's rebuild)
intentions.evidence: projector_worker.ex moduledoc: Oban uniqueness key includes :types (lvw-t11-followup-dedup) — without it a ['task'] rebuild job swallowed a subsequent ['paper'] enqueue in the same window with no retry; types normalized (sorted+deduped) at enqueue so order can't defeat the key.

intentions.title: Retroactively backfill graph edges for documents that predate an edge-extractor (e.g. valueref/wikilink), without a full data migration
intentions.evidence: backfill.ex: 'a paper that predates the body-walk extractor has ZERO valueref/wikilink edges until re-touched'; mix barkpark.edges.backfill dry-run vs --apply; reuses Projector.rebuild_scope/3 per (dataset, workspace_id) scope, publish-gated corpus.
